question: In which city is the headquarters of Indira Gandhi National Centre for Arts located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)** is India's most prestigious government-funded arts organisation.
 
• Its headquarters is located in **New Delhi**.
 
• It is a self-contained institute under the control of the Union Ministry of Culture. Prime Minister Shri Rajiv Gandhi unveiled the IGNCA on November 19, 1985, at a ceremony in which the symbolism of the various components was explicitly explained at various levels.
 
• The elements were brought together: **fire, water, soil, sky, and vegetation.**
 
• Five rocks from five important rivers were sculpted into sculptural forms: Sindhu (Indus), Ganga, Kaveri, Mahanadi, and Narmada (where the oldest ammonite fossils are found).
 
• These are still there at the location as a reminder of Indian culture's antiquity and the sacredness of her rivers and rocks.
 
• On** March 24, 1987**, the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts Trust was established and registered in **New Delhi.**
